title: OpenRouter model_activity row and analysis contract
description: Schema for one SQLite model_activity row. The x-analysis annotations define how the mixed batch and supplement dataset may be compared.

date.description: OpenRouter activity date. Existing rows may use YYYY-MM-DD or a midnight timestamp; normalize with substr(date, 1, 10).

variant_permaslug.description: Canonical model route identifier. It can include a route suffix such as :free.

variant.description: OpenRouter route variant, for example standard, free, thinking, or nitro.

requests_with_tool_call_errors.description: Requests containing at least one tool-call error, not the number of errors.

x-analysis.grain: one model route variant per OpenRouter activity day

provenance_table.name: activity_coverage

fields.batch_seen: 1 when the row has been observed in the whole-market batch endpoint
fields.supplement_seen: 1 when the row has been observed in model-activity with complete core telemetry

provenance_table.legacy_behavior: No matching coverage row means unknown provenance for data collected before provenance tracking.

batch.coverage: roughly 400+ model routes for one completed day per weekly run

supplement.coverage: 31 trailing days for the top-N routes selected at scrape time
supplement.conflict_policy: Preserve batch prompt, completion, and request counts so a whole-market snapshot remains on one data vintage.

quality_rules.rule: Use only dates with COUNT(*) >= 300 for cross-sectional whole-market comparisons. Determine these dates from the database; do not assume a fixed weekday.
Dates below the whole-market threshold are a changing top-N panel. Never sum them as total market traffic. Use a fixed cohort present on every compared day for longitudinal analysis.

A zero in reasoning, cached, or tool fields is missing telemetry when activity_coverage.batch_seen=1 and supplement_seen=0. Analyze these fields only where supplement_seen=1; a missing coverage row means unknown provenance.
Exclude the newest date from trend comparisons unless the day is known to be complete.
chart_series values are mutable rolling buckets. Current-week observations are partial and must be refreshed before comparison.

total_tokens.warning: Do not add reasoning or cached tokens again; they are telemetry subsets or parallel native counters and may overlap.

tokens_per_request.warning: This is workload shape, not latency, cost, users, or model quality.

reasoning_share.warning: Compare only supplement-covered fixed cohorts; provider reporting conventions may differ.

cached_share.warning: Compare only supplement-covered fixed cohorts; provider reporting conventions may differ.

tool_error_request_rate.warning: This is the share of requests with an error, not errors per tool call.

aggregation_rules: Keep variants separate when analyzing route behavior, pricing, or free-tier effects.
Combine all related route variants when estimating model-family or provider demand, and state the included variants explicitly.
Treat slug migrations as one family only after manual verification; a disappearing old slug and growing replacement slug is not necessarily churn.
Provider is commonly approximated by the prefix before '/', but this identifies the model publisher namespace, not necessarily the inference host.
known_historical_limitations: Rows collected before supplement-on-conflict updates and activity_coverage were implemented may retain batch zeros with unknown provenance.
The 31-day supplement window can repair recent top-N rows after upgrading, but older structural zeros cannot be reconstructed from this database alone.
Whole-market history begins only when the batch layer was introduced; earlier dates represent top models rather than all routes.
